extensions.means: The ACD etymon grouping a reconstruction's sets at successive levels (etyma.csv).
Members whose irregularity the ACD explains by metathesis, by index.
Members whose irregularity the ACD explains by assimilation, by index.
A cf.csv group's gloss, where the group names no reconstruction to carry it.
A cf.csv group's Name: the root (*-bag) of a root group, the heading gloss of a loan group.
The cognate set an 'also' group gives irregular forms beside (cf.csv Cognateset_ID).
The entry's lemma in LiLa's lemma bank.
LiLa's lila_link on an etymon, as written: the lemma ids of the entries it was made for, or 'nan' or '?'.

Every form of an etymon as LiLa writes it, read into parts: kind (canonical, other), group (LiLa's form node), form, label, hedge, relation to the record's form (variant, earlier, later, outcome), credit, lexinfo features and the string as written. The first is the record's form. `written` is kept in the store, never served.
LiLa's lexinfo features on the etymon itself (part of speech, gender), as property=value, its slips corrected.
LiLa's rdfs:label, where it differs from the record's form. Kept in the store, never served.
LiLa's rdfs:comments as written: its transcription of de Vaan's line, the entry an etymon was made for, its curators' review notes. Kept in the store, never served.

LiLa's cognate links (lemonEty:cognate, and the misspelt congnate), as record ids or LiLa lemmas. From an entry, documented (Mambrini and Passarotti 2020, sec. 3.4): the same word under another part of speech, or a duplicate lemma in LiLa. Between etymons, undocumented.
The holder's own stance when the asserter reports it: 'rejects' for 'denied by De Vaan'.
The sense a link concerns, by link index (the design's 'form or sense' claim kind).
A first attestation, from {{etydate}} or prose (the design's 'date' claim kind).
The {{R:...}} template (after its redirects) that cites the work in Wiktionary's wikitext; R|<lang> for a reference kept in a language's data module, read through {{R|<lang>|<key>}}.
